interpretation.first_open: Fresh process and owned file; OS caches were not dropped.
interpretation.first_pipe_open: Before any sync on a missing target: get_rowcount followed by exists, including first native Pipe context for v5. Constructor is outside the timer. Size labels denote prepared input frames, not existing table cardinalities.
interpretation.get_data: Fully materialized Pipe.get_data after fresh/idempotent/one-percent changed sync; value validation follows outside the timer.
interpretation.per_run_performance_accepted: Per-run false values preserve audit-time threshold/disposition state. The later rc1-only exception is recorded separately and does not change the failed raw thresholds.
interpretation.private_evidence: Unchanged detailed receipts remain private and are linked by content hash; paths, environments, credentials and dependency inventories are excluded.
interpretation.profile_timings: Separate diagnostic only; never replace the uninstrumented samples.
interpretation.rss: Whole worker peak, including validation; not sync-only RSS.
interpretation.samples: Original and three-extra-repeat confirmation remain separate; summary warm_select samples are per-cell medians of the three raw values.
interpretation.warm_select: Median of three public SQLConnector.value SELECT 1 calls per cell, after first SDK open.

followup_before_final_5_0_0: Investigate cold instance-table/catalog readiness while preserving public semantics.
Establish a verified final-schema handoff before relaxing post-sync cache invalidation.
Investigate large-frame/validation memory; preserve persistence and freshness.
Repeat unchanged comparisons after a supported optimization, or explicitly review a final-release limitation.

memory_limitation.interpretation: Repeatable measured resource tradeoff, not per-sync allocation, proof of a leak or a bound on concurrent-worker memory.

performance_disposition.scope: Four confirmed DuckDB timing flags and large-writer memory tradeoff; not blanket final-release acceptance.

attribution.cold_missing_target: Metadata initialization/hydration dominates this first-Pipe boundary. Successful instance-table readiness is connector/process-owned state, not inherently repeated for every Pipe sharing that initialized connector.
attribution.limits: Partial attribution only. One-repeat profiling perturbs the stacks; native/blocking-thread work is partly opaque. No exact allocation of the uninstrumented delta or complete SQL-query census is claimed.
attribution.post_sync_small_read: Native sync deliberately clears Python column/layout caches to prevent stale schema/dtype/parameter state. The next read reflects columns; simply keeping the old cache would undo an existing freshness repair.

post_measurement_runtime_change.scope: Base Python environment activation may reuse an already visible interpreter site after EACCES/EROFS prevents user-site creation; it does not recreate the base interpreter as a named environment.
